name: Steampunk P1: tools, storage and a small workshop at the base site
context: Read steampunk/DIRECTIVE.md first. Strategic purpose: every later machine needs tools, planks/stone, andesite and a place to keep items. Architecture: workshop is the first brick of the industrial district, built beside the existing wheel at x1090..1095, z-340..-335 (flat ground assumed; verify with mc_terrain). Frame spruce/dark oak, stone brick or cobble walls, glass windows, lanterns. Next objective: plans/steampunk-p2-power-bank.json.

steps.name: 8 logs
steps.goal: Chop ACACIA trees (acacia_log) until you hold 8 acacia logs (mc_find_blocks acacia_log radius 32 exposedOnly, then mc_mine). Stay away from x1082..1101, z-334..-328 machines.

steps.name: stone tools
steps.goal: Craft planks, sticks, 6 cobblestone then a stone pickaxe and a stone axe (skip if you already own them; the check passes then). Mine cobblestone from exposed stone with mc_find_blocks stone.

steps.name: stack of cobblestone
steps.goal: Mine cobblestone until you hold at least 64. You already own gravel; gravel is fine. Use exposed stone away from the machines.

steps.name: 3 chests
steps.goal: Craft 3 chests (8 planks each, ring around an empty centre in the 3x3 grid). You need a crafting table: use a nearby one or craft+place your own.

steps.name: glass for windows
steps.goal: Smelt sand into 8 glass in a furnace (furnace + fuel + sand from the shore or desert; mc_find_blocks sand). Fuel: logs or planks. Take the glass out when done.

steps.name: survey the workshop site
steps.goal: Run mc_terrain around x1092,z-338 radius 8. Report in your final line whether a 7x6 area is flat within +-1 block. If not, pick the nearest flat 7x6 area and state its corner coordinates. Do not place anything yet.

steps.name: workshop floor and frame
steps.goal: On the surveyed 7x6 area: place a cobblestone floor, then 4 log corner posts, 4 blocks tall. Work from the outside; remember your body must not overlap the target cell. Verify one corner post with mc_blocks.
steps.verify: floor 7x6 of cobblestone, 4 corner posts of logs height 4

steps.name: walls, windows, roof
steps.goal: Fill the walls with cobblestone between the posts, put glass in the middle two blocks of each long wall at height 2..3, leave a 1x2 door gap on a short wall, roof with planks. Place 2 lanterns or torches inside. Verify with mc_blocks along one wall.
steps.verify: walls of cobblestone, glass in the middle of the long walls, roof of planks, door gap

steps.name: furnishing: crafting, furnace, storage
steps.goal: Inside: place a crafting table, a furnace, and the 3 chests in a row against a wall. Put cobblestone surplus (keep 16) into chest 1. The check passes when all 3 chests have left your inventory.
